items.prompt: A Soviet kindergarten cloakroom: a row of small wooden lockers with painted pictures on the doors (no letters), tiny coats on hooks, felt boots below. The image is overexposed and patchy, like a single flash of memory with darkness around it.

alt.ru: Раздевалка детского сада: ряд маленьких шкафчиков с картинками, крошечные пальто, валенки; снимок пересвечен.
alt.en: A kindergarten cloakroom: a row of small lockers with pictures, tiny coats, felt boots; the picture is overexposed.
alt.pt: O vestiário de um jardim de infância: uma fila de armarinhos com desenhos, casacos minúsculos, botas de feltro; imagem superexposta.
alt.es: El guardarropa de una guardería: una fila de taquillas pequeñas con dibujos, abrigos diminutos, botas de fieltro; imagen sobreexpuesta.
